about.title: About the Club
about.subtitle: Much more than an association — we are a community of rock lovers.
about.img_caption: Board of Directors at Puig Campana
about.eco_title: For climbing compatible with the environment.
about.eco_p1: We are a community committed to responsible climbing and respect for the environment.
about.eco_p2: Our passion for this sport goes hand in hand with the care of the natural areas where we practice it. Collaborating with local organizations and authorities to ensure a balance between the enjoyment of climbing and the preservation of the environment.
about.eco_p3: Join us in our quest for conscious and respectful adventure in the beautiful Costa Blanca.
